title: 第288章 定心丸第287章 心劫
content_zh:
青海那边的事不能拖。
王建新把手里头的文件处理完，带上警卫，直奔了青海湖基地。
基地跟上次来又不一样了。地下三层的主体工程已经完工，墙面抹了灰，地面铺了防潮层，通风管道和供电线路全部走好了。虽然还有些收尾的活没干完，但基本能用了。
最底下的修炼密室最大，足有二千多平米，挑高也高，站里头不觉得憋屈，他站在密室正中央，闭上眼睛感应了一下，灵气的浓度一直在缓慢的提升，虽然跟他空间里头没法比，但足够练气期的修士用了。
队员已经提前到了，就是那一百个人，个个都是政治过硬、身体过硬的苗子。他们在基地里等了王建新三天，一个个憋着劲儿，就等着开练。
王建新把大家叫到修炼密室，让他们盘腿坐成一圈。
“今天开始，我教你们修炼。”王建新的声音不大，但每个字都清清楚楚，“这套功法叫《太初引灵诀》，心无杂念，意守丹田，鼻纳清灵，口吐尘烟，气随念走，遍绕周身，引灵入脉，始登仙缘。下面是心法口诀：眼观鼻，鼻观心，息绵长，意凝神，吸纳天地一缕灵，缓缓归入下丹田。
吐纳修炼口诀如下：
心如止水，万念皆空
吸如吞云，呼如抽风
引气入喉，顺脉而行
聚于气海，初开灵功
当你们有以下感应，便证明你们已经进入了练气一层。
1、初次感应天地灵气，毛孔可纳清气
2、经脉初步温润，身体百病渐消
3、体力远超凡人，奔跑不倦
4、丹田初聚微茫气旋，正式踏入仙途。
你们只需要照着我教的方法去做。
一百个人闭上眼睛，按照王建新教的方法开始尝试。
王建新没有急着走，而是坐在密室正中间，神识笼罩着这一百个人，一个不漏地观察着他们的反应。

大约过了半个钟头，有人的呼吸节奏开始变了，从原来的急促变得平稳绵长。王建新的神识捕捉到一丝微弱的灵气开始往那个人的体内渗透，速度不快，但很稳定。
又过了十来分钟，第二个人也有了反应。
一个下午下来，一百个人里头有八十九个成功感应到了灵气，剩下的十一个稍微慢一点，但也摸到了门槛。
王建新心里头踏实了不少。看来咱们国人的体质并不差，以前修炼不了纯粹是因为没有灵气。只要有灵气在，大家都能练，而且入门并不难。
接下来的一个星期，王建新天天泡在密室里，手把手地教。从引灵入体到灵气运转，从丹田蓄气到打通经脉，每一步都讲得仔仔细细。这些队员底子好，悟性也不差，学得很快。
到了第七天，一百个人全部能够自主入定了。他们盘腿坐在蒲团上，双目微闭，呼吸均匀，周身有一股极淡极淡的灵气流转。普通人看不出来，但王建新的神识看得清清楚楚。
按照这个速度，用不了多久，他们就能突破到练气一层。
王建新又观察了两天，确认没有问题，才放下了心。他把基地的后勤负责人叫过来，叮嘱了几件事：伙食一定要好，营养一定要跟上；每天保证八小时睡眠，不能熬夜练；每练三天休息一天，劳逸结合。后勤负责人一个劲地点头，拿着小本本都记下来了。
临走之前，王建新又去密室里看了一眼。一百个人正坐成一排一排，安安静静地修炼着。密室里头灵气氤氲，虽然还有些稀薄，但已经有了那么点意思。
王建新没有打扰他们，转身出了门。
国家的班底，算是打下基础了。剩下的就是按部就班，急不得。
回到京城，王建新又忙了起来。
他把自己关在办公室里，开始写修炼功法。从练气一层到筑基大圆满，每一层该怎么练、会遇到什么问题、需要注意什么事项，全都写得详详细细。有些地方光用文字说不清楚，他还画了图，标注灵气运行的路线和穴位的位置。
这些东西，他脑子里早就有了，但真要落到纸面上，还得一个字一个字地斟酌。写浅了怕后人看不懂，写深了怕他们领会不了。王建新写了改、改了写，反反复复折腾了一个多星期，总算弄出了一套完整的功法手册。
写完之后，他把手册装进牛皮纸档案袋里，封好，带着去了老首长家。
老首长正在书房里看文件，见他来了，放下手中的笔，摘下老花镜。
content_en:
Things in Qinghai cannot be delayed.
Wang Jianxin finished processing the documents in his possession, took the guards with him, and went straight to the Qinghai Lake base.
The base is different from last time. The main work on the three underground floors has been completed. The walls have been plastered, the floor has been paved with a moisture-proof layer, and the ventilation ducts and power supply lines have all been routed. Although there are still some finishing touches to be done, it is basically ready for use.
The secret practice room at the bottom was the largest, with an area of ​​more than 2,000 square meters and a high ceiling. He did not feel uncomfortable standing in it. He stood in the center of the secret room, closed his eyes and sensed it. The concentration of spiritual energy had been slowly increasing. Although it was not comparable to that in his space, it was enough for a monk in the Qi training period.
The team members have arrived ahead of schedule, that is, the one hundred people, all of them are politically strong and physically strong young people. They waited for Wang Jianxin at the base for three days, holding back their energy, waiting to start training.
Wang Jianxin called everyone to the secret practice room and asked them to sit cross-legged in a circle.
"Starting today, I will teach you how to practice." Wang Jianxin's voice was not loud, but every word was clear. "This set of exercises is called "Taichu Ling Ling Jue". There are no distracting thoughts in the heart, the mind is guarding the Dantian, the nose is clear, the mouth is Exhale the dust and smoke, and let the breath follow the thoughts, all over the body, attracting the spirit into the veins, and then you can ascend to the immortal realm. The following is the heart method: look at the nose with eyes, watch the heart with nose, take a long breath, concentrate on the mind, absorb a wisp of spirit from heaven and earth, and slowly return to the lower Dantian.
The breathing practice formula is as follows:
The heart is like still water, all thoughts are empty
Inhaling like swallowing clouds, exhaling like convulsing wind
Introduce the air into the throat and follow the pulse
Gathering in the sea of qi, the spiritual power is first opened
When you feel the following sensation, it proves that you have entered the first level of Qi training.
1. Sensing the aura of heaven and earth for the first time, the pores can receive fresh air
2. The meridians initially become warm and moist, and all diseases of the body gradually disappear.
3. His physical strength far exceeds that of ordinary people, and he can run tirelessly
4. A faint cyclone gathers in Dantian, officially entering the path of immortality.
You just need to do it the way I teach you.
One hundred people closed their eyes and started trying according to Wang Jianxin's method.
Wang Jianxin did not leave in a hurry, but sat in the middle of the secret room, his consciousness covering the hundred people, observing their reactions one by one.
About half an hour later, someone's breathing rhythm began to change, from rapid to steady and long. Wang Jianxin's consciousness caught a faint trace of spiritual energy and began to penetrate into that person's body. The speed was not fast, but it was very stable.
After another ten minutes, the second person also reacted.
At the end of the afternoon, eighty-nine out of a hundred people successfully sensed the spiritual energy. The remaining eleven were a little slower, but they also touched the threshold.
Wang Jianxin felt a lot more at ease. It seems that the physique of our countrymen is not bad. In the past, we could not practice cultivation simply because we did not have spiritual energy. As long as there is spiritual energy, everyone can practice it, and it is not difficult to get started.
For the next week, Wang Jianxin stayed in the secret room every day and taught him step by step. From introducing the spirit into the body to the circulation of spiritual energy, from accumulating energy in the Dantian to opening up the meridians, every step is explained in detail. These team members have good foundation and good understanding, and they learn quickly.
On the seventh day, all one hundred people were able to enter concentration independently. They sat cross-legged on the futon, with their eyes slightly closed, breathing evenly, and a very light spiritual energy flowing around their bodies. Ordinary people can't see it, but Wang Jianxin's spiritual consciousness can see it clearly.
At this rate, it won't take long for them to break through to the first level of Qi training.
Wang Jianxin observed it for another two days and was relieved after confirming that there was no problem. He called the logistics director of the base over and told him a few things: the food must be good and nutrition must be kept up; he must sleep eight hours a day and not stay up late to practice; he must take one day off every three days to practice and balance work and rest. The person in charge of logistics nodded and took a small notebook to write everything down.
Before leaving, Wang Jianxin took another look in the secret room. One hundred people were sitting in rows, practicing quietly. There is a lot of spiritual energy in the secret room, although there are stillA little thin, but it already has some meaning.
Wang Jianxin did not disturb them and turned around and walked out.
The national team has laid the foundation. All that's left is to follow the steps and not rush.
Back in the capital, Wang Jianxin became busy again.
He locked himself in his office and began to write down exercises. From the first level of Qi training to the perfection of foundation building, how to practice each level, what problems you will encounter, and what needs to be paid attention to are all written in detail. Some places couldn't be explained with words alone, but he also drew pictures to mark the route of spiritual energy and the location of acupuncture points.
He had already had these things in his mind, but when it came time to put them on paper, he had to consider them word by word. If you write it shallowly, you are afraid that future generations will not be able to understand it; if you write it deeply, you are afraid that they will not be able to understand it. Wang Jianxin wrote, rewritten, and rewritten it over and over again for more than a week, and finally came up with a complete set of exercise manuals.
After writing it, he put the manual into a brown paper portfolio, sealed it, and took it to the old chief's house.
The old chief was reading documents in the study room. When he saw him coming, he put down the pen in his hand and took off his reading glasses.
